unknowns: Effort: only the recorded 'effort' and 'perTurnEffort' fields are reported. The files do not show how the effort level was chosen or whether the service applied it exactly.
Model: 'observedModels' is the message.model value recorded in each assistant entry. The files do not show a separate serving deployment or provider.

Tool availability: the tool list each agent was given is not recorded. Only the tool calls actually made are listed. Depth-2 and depth-3 planners made no Agent tool calls, so their ability to spawn agents is unobserved.
Parent of depth-1 agents: meta.parentAgentId is absent. The parent is the root session because each toolUseId matches a top-level Agent tool call in the root session file.
System prompts, skill-loading context, and tool schemas are not reported. Prompt text is not included; only promptSha256 of the first string user message is given.

Subagent transcripts record the planner's own text. Copies delivered to the root session as task notifications or hand-backs may differ in escaping or wrapping (for example, '>' appeared as '>' in those copies). finalText here is taken from the subagent transcript.

Root session sourceSha256 covers the whole file, which the live session still appends to, including the excluded follow-up. Re-hash before relying on it. Subagent files are complete and their hashes are stable.
Timestamps are the UTC values recorded in the files. They are not verified against the server clock, and no timing or score is derived from them.
Completeness: these are the only planner transcripts present in this session directory. Planner runs not written to these files cannot be detected from here.
The claude binary itself was not hashed. CLI version is taken from the 'version' field in the transcripts (2.1.296), matching 'claude --version'.
Excluded: thinking text and signatures, account and user metadata, cwd and git branch, environment dumps, and credentials.
